description: This file defines the EmployeeAttachmentDao class, which provides data access methods for employee attachment entities in the OrangeHRM HR management system. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, and deleting employee attachment records in the database.

classes.name: EmployeeAttachmentDao
classes.description: Data access object class for managing employee attachment records in the database, including retrieving, saving, and deleting attachments.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttachments
methods.description: Retrieves a list of partial employee attachments for a specific employee and screen, ordered by attachment ID.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Fetches a specific employee attachment by employee number, attachment ID, and optionally screen.

methods.name: getPartialEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Retrieves a single partial employee attachment based on employee number, attachment ID, and screen.

methods.name: saveEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Saves a new or existing employee attachment, assigning an attachment ID if not set.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeAttachments
methods.description: Deletes multiple employee attachments based on employee number, screen, and list of attachment IDs.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Removes a specific employee attachment object from the database.
